files_digest_method: sha256 of the lines '<path> <sha256>\n' for every file, sorted by path
format: one JSON file per entity, files[<entity>].path: {"cube", "entity", "columns", "rows", "windows"}; rows hold every appt_group at grains month, quarter, fy and admin; windows[<administration>] = {month_0, months, file_version (month 0 first)}. Plus files.admin, the admin view (see views)

admin.description: every entity x appt_group x administration at one months_in_office value: N = the entity's Trump II months so far (D-072; a component that ended has its own, D-024), the same N for every administration whose window reaches it; rows are copies of the entity files' admin rows in these columns; file {"cube", "view", "columns", "rows", "months_in_office", "windows"}, windows as in the entity files

manifest_hash_method: sha256 of data/opm_manifest.json canonical content: records sorted by (dataset, filename), json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
spec: docs/pages/appointments.md sections 3, 4, 6 (signed, D-086; D-084, D-085); D-024, D-065, D-066

columns.name: entity
columns.description: 'DOJ' for the department total, else the component's agency_subelement_code (pipeline/crosswalks/components.csv); display names belong to the front end

columns.name: appt_group
columns.description: 'all', an appointment group or a political subgroup (pipeline/crosswalks/appointment_groups.csv, D-086); see meta groups

columns.name: appt_level
columns.description: 'total' (all), 'group' (the groups partition all, unknown included) or 'subgroup' (the subgroups partition political)

columns.name: grain
columns.description: 'month', 'quarter' (fiscal), 'fy' (FY2025 = Oct 2024 to Sep 2025) or 'admin' (administration x months in office, D-065, D-066)

columns.name: period
columns.description: 'YYYY-MM', 'FYyyyyQn', 'FYyyyy', or at admin grain the administration id (obama2, trump1, biden, trump2; names in the meta)

columns.name: fiscal_year
columns.description: fiscal year of the period; null at admin grain

columns.name: fiscal_quarter
columns.description: fiscal quarter 1 to 4 (Q1 = Oct to Dec); null at fy and admin grain

columns.name: months_in_office
columns.description: admin grain: N, months in office, month 1 = January of the inauguration year (D-066); null otherwise

columns.name: admin_months
columns.description: admin grain: published months of the administration's window, up to the entity's last month (D-024); null otherwise

columns.name: period_first_month
columns.description: first calendar month of the period (YYYY-MM), published or not; admin grain: month 1

columns.name: period_last_month
columns.description: last published month of the period (YYYY-MM), the month stocks are taken from; admin grain: month N

columns.name: months_in_period
columns.description: calendar months in the period: 1, 3 or 12; admin grain: N

columns.name: months_published
columns.description: months of the period with a published employment file, up to the entity's last employment month (D-024); admin grain: N

columns.name: time_basis
columns.description: 'effective': hires and departures counted by personnel_action_effective_date_month (invariant 6)

columns.name: file_version
columns.description: one entry per published month of the period: 'YYYY-MM eN aN sN' = employment, accessions and separations file versions; null at admin grain, where each file carries windows[<administration>].file_version (month 0 first)

columns.name: provisional
columns.description: the period (admin grain: months 1..N) contains any of the newest 3 effective months (invariant 8)

columns.name: partial
columns.description: the period has months not yet published or after the entity's last employment month (invariant 3, D-024); admin grain: the administration is still in office (Trump II)

columns.name: reissued
columns.description: a month of the period (admin grain: month 0 or 1..N) changed file version since the previous manifest (revision_baseline.json)

columns.name: opm_incomplete
columns.description: a month of the period OPM marks incomplete for DOJ; currently none

columns.name: headcount
columns.description: employment rows of the group in period_last_month (admin grain: month N); never summed across months

columns.name: headcount_all
columns.description: employment rows of the entity in period_last_month, all groups: the 'all' headcount, the denominator of share

columns.name: share
columns.description: headcount / headcount_all, same month, 4 decimals (spec section 4); null when headcount_all is 0

columns.name: hires
columns.description: accession rows whose appointment type is in the group, effective in the period (admin grain: running sum over months 1..N); transfers in included

columns.name: departures
columns.description: separation rows whose appointment type is in the group, effective in the period (admin grain: running sum over months 1..N); transfers out and DRP included

columns.name: month_0
columns.description: admin grain: the last month-end before month 1 (YYYY-MM); null otherwise

columns.name: headcount_0
columns.description: admin grain: headcount of the group at month 0; null otherwise

columns.name: headcount_change
columns.description: admin grain: headcount minus headcount_0 (D-066); not derived from flows (invariant 7; conversions between groups are not hires or departures); null otherwise

columns.name: headcount_change_pct
columns.description: admin grain: headcount_change / headcount_0, 4 decimals (a fraction); null where headcount_0 < 30 (spec section 4: a count only); null at other grains

columns.name: pct_small_base
columns.description: admin grain: headcount_0 < 30, so headcount_change_pct is null; null at other grains
